hero.headline: off for students
hero.subtext: Studying design or development? Get half off the Solo plan for your first year, or any Landmark Kit. Ask with your university email and we send you a code.

steps.headline: How it works

items.title: Send the form
items.body: Your name, your university and the email your school gave you.

items.title: We check it

items.title: Use your code

rules: The code works once and runs for 30 days.
One discount per checkout, so it does not stack with regional or member pricing.
We may cancel a code that went to someone who is not a current student.

request.headline: Ask for your code
request.subtext: Takes a minute. We reply within a couple of days.

form.emailHint: The one your school gave you. Your code goes here.
form.proofHint: Only if your email doesn't show your school: a link to your student ID or enrolment letter.

errors.url: Enter a full link like https://...

form.failed: Could not send your request. Try again.
form.doneBody: We check every request by hand and reply within a couple of days. Keep an eye on {email}.

items.a: Anyone currently enrolled at a university, college or coding school. If your email doesn't show your school, add a link to your student ID or enrolment letter.
Every Solo payment in your first 12 months is half price, quarterly or yearly. After that it renews at the normal price, and you can cancel any time before it does.

items.q: Can I use it on a Landmark Kit instead?
items.a: Yes. The code takes 50% off the Reveal or Menu Kit. It works once, so it covers one purchase.

items.q: Does the money-back guarantee still apply?
items.a: Yes, for the Library. The 14-day money-back guarantee works the same with a student code, on the terms in the refund policy. Landmark Kits are final sale, with or without a code.

items.q: Can I use it for client work?
items.a: Yes. The license is the same as any other plan, so anything you build with it, for yourself or for clients, is covered.

endCta.headline: Browse the library first
endCta.subtext: Every component has a live preview, so you know what you get before you ask.
